description:
In today's shader tutorial, we add a parameter to our simple lighting model to control how metallic the surface is. And we a adjust the model so it includes the math required for metallic surfaces.

Take a look at the playlist for the whole series:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL78XDi0TS4lGnGa7L2X4o3UV-XYZEKNwj

Here's last week's video on putting together the simple lighting model:
https://youtu.be/pxp68A6Wlfg
